name: dream-lang
description: Dream language support: syntax, diagnostics, go to definition, hover and outline, from the Dream compiler itself.

dream.vm.path.markdownDescription: The Dream virtual machine. `lucid` is a compiled image rather than a native program, so it is run by the VM.

dream.server.path.markdownDescription: The `lucid.dream` image to run as the language server. Left empty, the extension looks for `build/lucid.dream` and `build-dream/bin/lucid.dream` in the workspace, then `$LUCID_IMAGE`.

dream.packagePaths.markdownDescription: Extra directories to search for packages, passed to the server as `-L`. The workspace folder is always included.

dream.stdlib.path.markdownDescription: The directory holding the `std` package. Left empty, `$MIND_STDLIB` is used if it is set.

dream.trace.server.description: Log the conversation with the language server.
